items.title: What's different about Microsoft's Copilot AI reboot
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) launched a reboot of Copilot, shifting its focus from personal AI to workplace use. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what you should know.

items.title: CEO Satya Nadella on Microsoft's AI bet
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa sat down with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella to discuss its cloud-based Autopilot update, consumer trust in AI agents, and how US and China might find common ground on AI development and safety as Chinese President Xi Jinping visits Washington to meet with President Trump.

items.title: Qualcomm's CMO reveals the secret behind Snapdragon's rise
items.summary: Qualcomm CMO Don McGuire joins In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen at Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Summit in Maui, for an in-depth look at how a chip you can't even buy off a shelf became one of the biggest brands in tech, sports, and AI. He breaks down the brand strategy turning an invisible chip into a household name, why Microsoft's consumer Surface lineup is now 100% powered by Snapdragon, and the company’s groundbreaking partnerships with Manchester United and Mercedes F1.

items.title: Satya Nadella sees that China and the US both want AI to help their citizens
items.summary: Deirdre Bosa talks with Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Satya Nadella about how the US and China might find common ground on AI development and safety as Chinese President Xi Jinping visits Washington to meet with President Trump.

items.title: Goldman Sachs just gave AI stock fans a cold, hard reality check
items.summary: Goldman Sachs strategist Ryan Hammond thinks hyperscalers like Amazon, Oracle, and Microsoft need to generate about $300 billion in AI revenue in the "next few years" to break even on their investments.

items.title: S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq End Week Higher On Chipmaker Strength, Easing Oil Amid Signs Of Easing US-Iran Conflict — META, COST, MSFT, CRWD, SKHY In Focus
items.summary: Iran pitched a seven-day roadmap to end conflict with the U.S., the New York Times reported.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Outweighs Microsoft in This Popular Dow ETF, and Share Price Is the Only Reason
items.summary: One number buried inside a popular Dow ETF quietly hands a smaller company more of your retirement dollars than a corporate giant worth more than ten times as much, and the reason has nothing to do with performance, profit, or business fundamentals.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 25: Microsoft Stock Jumps 4% After Revamping Copilot With Code Generation and Agentic AI Tools
items.summary: On Sept. 25, 2026, the productivity giant unveiled new AI capabilities designed to widen adoption and support premium monetization across its suite.
